question: In India, during a National Emergency, who may extend the term of Legislative Assemblies for a period not exceeding one year at a time?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Constitution of India** allows the extension of the term of Legislative Assemblies during a **National Emergency**.
 
• As per **Article 356** of the Indian Constitution, the authority to extend the Legislative Assembly's term lies with the **Parliament**.
